capabilities: Plan multi-phase strength training blocks with sets, reps and progression rules
Log today's session with a self-ticking checklist and exercise swaps
Track progress with a muscle body map, strength trends and progress photos
Track daily habits and desk-work breaks with reminders and history
Run an AI coach in Claude Code for intake, plan design and weekly check-ins
extras: Free during beta; version 1.0 will be paid but installs before 1.0 stay free. Desktop only, built and tested on macOS; not medical advice. The plugin makes no network requests; the coach sends data to Anthropic under the user's own account.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to plan training, log workouts or track fitness habits, so athletes must keep this data in separate apps.

requires.name: Claude plan that includes Claude Code

summary: Strength training coach that plans workouts, logs sessions, tracks habits and reviews progress in your vault, with an AI coach in Claude Code.
